Congo Ebola Outbreak Enters Crisis Mode

A strike by health workers in the Democratic Republic of Congo has highlighted the dire situation in the country's Ebola outbreak, which continues to spread despite international efforts. The crisis is further complicated by unpaid wages for healthcare workers, who are threatening to abandon their posts. This development underscores the need for urgent action to address the root causes of the outbreak and ensure that those affected receive necessary support.
